# Source:age

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.2</span></div>

Get the last value age (only for Telemetry sources)

```lua
source:age()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

value age in milliseconds (integer)

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
source = system.getSource("ALT")
print(source:age())
```
